profile_text.body:
Anthropic is a for-profit AI safety and research company founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company's website describes its AI, Claude, as built for problem solvers, with capabilities spanning complex reasoning, data analysis, and code writing.

Anthropic's primary product is Claude, a general-purpose large language model assistant available at claude.ai. The company also offers the Anthropic Console, an API management platform with tools for prompt testing, evaluation, usage monitoring, and cost controls, as well as Claude Code, an agentic coding tool, and a Computer Use capability described as a computer control agent able to perform desktop automation and high-privilege operations.

The held facts record twelve active legal cases involving Anthropic across multiple federal courts, including the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals, the Northern District of California, the District of Delaware, the District of Vermont, the District of Hawaii, and the Eastern District of Pennsylvania. Notable cases include University of Tennessee Research Foundation v. Anthropic PBC in Delaware and a collection of plaintiff cases such as Smith v. Anthropic, Patel v. Anthropic, and Shakespeare v. Anthropic filed in the Northern District of California.
